messages:
sam: quick convo: default behavior for automatic fallback (latency/error/capacity triggers) — should we be silent (200 + header) or explicit (5xx with reason)? need a default for hosted + dedicated; per-tenant override too. ping @anya @chris

anya: silent by default. most apps want continuity. but we must give clear observability hooks so teams can detect silent degradations.

chris: silent w/ headers + sample sounds good. add a per-route override flag `fallback_behavior=strict|silent|transparent`. strict -> explicit error; transparent -> 200 + body field `degraded_reason`.

sam: agree. header name suggestion: `x-redwood-fallback: policy=latency;variant=lite;sampled=0` and if sampled also `x-redwood-fallback-id: <uuid>`. sampled events should include trace_id and policy_id.

log-bot: note: existing audit-store schema requires event_type and trace_id. add fallback events as `fallback_decision` with link to fallback_id.

anya: privacy note: sampled payloads must be scrubbed by default. store full replay only behind operator RBAC and signed short-lived URLs. enterprise retention default 90d.

chris: console UX: show "fallback timeline" per-route + top example traces. one-click "replay in sandbox" for sampled traces. replay must be gated.

sam: rollout plan: 1) headers + sampling + audit event (0.1% default); 2) SDK surfaces Response.fallbackMeta; 3) per-route override; 4) console timeline + replay gating + retention settings. owners: chris -> SDK/docs, anya -> audit + retention, sam -> console mock + RFC.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 2026-06-30T22:00 by @ci.

chris: i'll add API param and update swagger. anya: can you draft the audit schema in RW-9001?

anya: on it. +1

sam: +1
